# Phase Three — Critique, Corrections, and Thirty Improvements

The Awtsmoos renews the plan before the plan can become an idol; Awtsmoos.com therefore lets each critique uncover one more hidden boundary where tomorrow's bug might otherwise grow.

1. Correct URL-root assumptions before declaring a file missing.
2. Distinguish route-local CSS from shared component CSS.
3. Map all importers before editing shared assets.
4. Preserve component contracts even when route styling becomes local.
5. Keep document identity on both `html` and `body` only when document-level rules genuinely need both.
6. Prefer semantic layer tokens over raw integers.
7. Keep component-internal layer tokens separate from page overlay layers.
8. Verify fixed/sticky content clearance, not only stacking values.
9. Treat 320px horizontal stability as a verification target, not an assumption.
10. Never use overflow clipping to conceal oversized descendants.
11. Verify max-content pills/ribbons are inside explicit scroll owners.
12. Ensure mobile sheets respect safe-area insets.
13. Ensure dialogs remain focusable and closable by keyboard.
14. Give native `<details>` complete summary states.
15. Give text inputs focus, invalid, disabled, and read-only states when used.
16. Give card-links focus and active feedback, not hover only.
17. Use coarse-pointer media queries to remove hover-only displacement.
18. Keep reduced-motion behavior functionally equivalent.
19. Prefer transform/opacity animation over layout animation.
20. Split files at responsibility seams before they exceed the ceiling.
21. Keep manifests tiny and declarative.
22. Keep boot JavaScript as dependency assembly, not business logic.
23. Move repeated selectors/event names into explicit registries when repetition causes drift.
24. Separate transport errors from validation and rendering errors.
25. Preserve AbortSignal/timeout contracts for async APIs.
26. Run route-specific tests before broad suites.
27. Read back every rewritten file completely.
28. Check leading-space indentation in every touched human-authored source file.
29. Record planned-vs-actual delta after each route family.
30. Update REMAINING_WORK whenever discovery creates new obligations.

## Revised priority

Home integration closure → Docs route family → Drive route family → authoring/Heichel → profile/social/auth → media/admin/tools → procedural-world pages → docs/handoff → final discovery sweep.
